coverage.coverage_statement: Initial controlled CORE-area benchmark. Google collection stopped at the approved API budget; figures are a coverage floor, not a city total.

controls.claim: 178 potential Grab-side incremental candidates; not 178 confirmed active non-Google salons.
controls.tier1_definition: Direct reciprocal Google probe using business name, address and coordinates; priority enrichment queue.
controls.tier2_definition: Area-coverage evidence only; requires a direct probe before any absence claim.
controls.release_gate: Category validation + contact/social enrichment + complete 16-step Google exclusion + activity confirmation + independent QA.
